name: Snow Swarm
description: A dot plot whose dots fall like snow and settle at their values, piling up without overlapping, and drift to new places when regrouped.

props.name: points
props.type: { value: number; group: string; label: string }[]
props.description: One dot per point. value sets its place along the axis exactly; dots pile upward from the axis where values crowd. label names the dot in the tooltip.

props.name: groups
props.description: The groups in order, for colours, lanes and the legend. Groups found in the points but not listed are added after. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: split
props.description: Give each group its own lane. Changing it, or the order of groups, makes the dots drift to their new places.

props.name: domain
props.description: The range of the axis. Defaults to a rounded range around the values.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Values to label on the axis. Defaults to a few round values.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip, legend and table, e.g. as dates. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatTick
props.description: Writes the axis labels. Defaults to format.

props.name: valueName
props.description: What the value is, for the tooltip and table, e.g. "First snow".

props.name: groupName
props.description: What the groups are, for the tooltip and table, e.g. "Region".

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels, including the axis. Dots shrink if a pile would not fit.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show each group's median under the plot.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the groups and medians when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header, such as a switch between one pile and a lane per group.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts note, delta and every other prop of a div.
